name: Julie Burn MBA
headline: Vice President | Global Professional Services & Delivery | £500m+ P&L Leadership | ERP (SAP S/4HANA, Workday, D365), SaaS & Cloud | Private Equity Value Creation | Margin & Operational Stabilisation
position: Founder & Vice President – Professional Services & Delivery
about:
Vice President-level Professional Services, Delivery Management and Operations executive specialising in building, stabilising, scaling and commercially optimising complex enterprise delivery organisations across ERP, SaaS, Cloud and AI-enabled transformation environments.
Leads global service delivery and portfolio management across multi-year, multi-country transformation programmes, with full P&L accountability for portfolios exceeding £500m TCV and organisations of 300–1,000+ consultants.
Trusted by FTSE100 enterprises and Private Equity sponsors to build, scale and transform Professional Services organisations, strengthen delivery discipline and restore commercial control where growth, integration complexity or transformation risk impacts revenue, EBITDA and margin performance.
Key areas of focus:
• ERP, SaaS, Cloud and AI-enabled enterprise transformation
• Professional Services leadership, delivery management and portfolio governance
• P&L ownership, EBITDA improvement, margin optimisation and forecast accuracy
• Global delivery operating model design and organisational scale
• Revenue growth, customer outcomes, utilisation improvement and cost optimisation
• Programme recovery, risk management and enterprise assurance
• Private Equity value creation, carve-out and integration programmes
Selected impact:
• Directed £500m+ TCV global delivery portfolios with full commercial accountability
• Mobilised and delivered 75+ complex enterprise transformation programmes
• Achieved sustained double-digit revenue growth and measurable margin improvement
• Delivered 30% efficiency gains and 25% cost reduction across technology estates
• Restored high-risk portfolios to >95% delivery predictability and financial control
• Reduced manual effort by 50% through AI-led automation and process redesign
Recognised for commercially disciplined executive leadership that builds, stabilises and scales delivery organisations, accelerates growth, improves margin performance and converts strategy into durable enterprise value.
Selectively open to Vice President-level Professional Services, Delivery and Operations mandates across enterprise and PE-backed environments.
